reading: US President Donald Trump has announced plans to establish an "AI Force" and designate an artificial intelligence tsar, despite widespread concerns regarding the emergent technology.
He affirmed that his administration would not "in any way hinder or stifle the growth" of the industry, resisting calls for a slowdown to implement better safeguards.
Trump did not offer specific details or a timeline for these initiatives.
He characterized AI as "the next Industrial Revolution," predicting it could contribute up to 25% of the country's GDP.
Furthermore, Trump expressed his desire for the US to maintain its lead over China in artificial intelligence, a key area of their ongoing rivalry.
AI development is a central aspect of the US-China rivalry, with both major economies competing for technological superiority.
The president also stated his administration would employ existing legal frameworks to address any "bad actors" utilizing AI.
He reiterated his view that criticisms and concerns about AI's potential dangers constitute a "hoax."
This stance comes as claims from researchers, including one suggesting over a 10% risk of AI "killing all humans," have recently raised alarm bells.
Major AI companies are actively racing to develop advanced systems, including theoretical "super intelligence" superior to human intellect.
Industry leaders like Anthropic's Dario Amodei have advocated for a deceleration of AI development, proposing industry-wide regulation and independent monitoring.
Another co-founder, Jack Clark, suggested that a "kill switch" checked by a third party might become mandatory for the sector.
Despite warnings prompting US lawmakers to propose legislation, OpenAI's Sam Altman indicated that Washington struggles to keep pace with regulating the new technology.
Altman stated that people should have more faith in AI firms to act responsibly, acknowledging the significant implications.
In the UK, Members of Parliament and peers have identified human rights risks from AI, arguing that current laws are ill-equipped to manage its rapid expansion.
The Joint Committee on Human Rights has published a report recommending a new AI bill to adequately address these severe threats.

vocabulary.definition: To officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose or position.
Stated something strongly and publicly to be true or to be the case.
New plans or processes intended to achieve a particular aim or solve a problem.
Described the distinctive nature or features of something.
In addition to what has already been said; used to introduce a further relevant point.
The state of being better, greater, or stronger than others.
To make use of something, such as a method, tool, or legal framework, for a particular purpose.
Repeated something already said, typically for emphasis or clarity.
To be regarded as forming or making up something; to amount to.
Publicly recommended or supported a particular cause, policy, or course of action.

entries.ja: 特定の目的や役職のために、誰かや何かを公式に選ぶこと。
entries.ko: 특정한 목적이나 직책을 위해 공식적으로 누군가나 무언가를 선택하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 正式地选择某人或某事物用于特定目的或职位。
entries.es: Elegir oficialmente a alguien o algo para un propósito o puesto particular.
entries.pt-BR: Escolher oficialmente alguém ou algo para um propósito ou cargo específico.

entries.ja: 何かが真実である、または事実であると強く公に述べた。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이 사실이거나 실제로 그렇다고 강력하게 공개적으로 진술했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 强烈且公开地声明某事是真的或情况如此。
entries.es: Declarar algo de forma enérgica y pública como verdadero o como un hecho.
entries.pt-BR: Declarar algo de forma forte e pública como sendo verdade ou como sendo o caso.

entries.ja: 特定の目的を達成したり問題を解決したりすることを意図した新しい計画やプロセス。
entries.ko: 특정한 목표를 달성하거나 문제를 해결하기 위해 고안된 새로운 계획이나 과정.
entries.zh-Hans: 旨在实现特定目标或解决问题的新计划或过程。
entries.es: Nuevos planes o procesos destinados a lograr un objetivo particular o resolver un problema.
entries.pt-BR: Novos planos ou processos destinados a alcançar um objetivo específico ou resolver um problema.

entries.ja: 何かの特徴的な性質や特長を述べた。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 독특한 본질이나 특징을 묘사했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 描述了某事物的独特性质或特征。
entries.es: Describió la naturaleza o las características distintivas de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Descreveu a natureza ou as características distintivas de algo.

entries.ja: すでに述べられたことに加えて、さらに関連する点を導入するために使用される言葉。
entries.ko: 이미 언급된 내용에 더해, 추가적인 관련 요점을 소개할 때 사용된다.
entries.zh-Hans: 除了已经说过的话之外；用于引入一个进一步的相关观点。
entries.es: Además de lo que ya se ha dicho; se usa para introducir un punto relevante adicional.
entries.pt-BR: Além do que já foi dito; usado para introduzir um ponto relevante adicional.

entries.ja: 他のものよりも優れている、大きい、または強い状態。
entries.ko: 다른 것들보다 더 좋거나, 더 크거나, 더 강한 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 比其他事物更好、更大或更强的状态。
entries.es: El estado de ser mejor, mayor o más fuerte que otros.
entries.pt-BR: O estado de ser melhor, maior ou mais forte que los demás.

entries.ja: 特定の目的のために、方法、道具、または法的枠組みなどの何かを利用すること。
entries.ko: 특정 목적을 위해 방법, 도구 또는 법적 틀과 같은 것을 사용하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 利用某物，例如方法、工具或法律框架，用于特定目的。
entries.es: Hacer uso de algo, como un método, herramienta o marco legal, para un propósito particular.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer uso de algo, como um método, ferramenta ou estrutura legal, para um propósito específico.

entries.ja: すでに言ったことを、通常は強調または明確化のために繰り返した。
entries.ko: 이미 말한 것을 반복한 것으로, 일반적으로 강조하거나 명확히 하기 위함이다.
entries.zh-Hans: 重复了已经说过的话，通常是为了强调或澄清。
entries.es: Repetir algo ya dicho, típicamente para enfatizar o clarificar.
entries.pt-BR: Repetiu algo já dito, tipicamente para ênfase ou clareza.

entries.ja: 何かを形成したり構成したりすると見なされること。ある量に達すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 형성하거나 구성하는 것으로 간주되다; 어떤 양에 해당하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 被认为是构成或组成某物；等同于。
entries.es: Ser considerado como parte o constituyente de algo; equivaler a.
entries.pt-BR: Ser considerado como formando ou compondo algo; equivaler a.

entries.ja: 特定の原因、政策、または行動方針を公に推奨または支持した。
entries.ko: 특정 원인, 정책 또는 행동 방침을 공개적으로 권장하거나 지지했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 公开推荐或支持某一特定事业、政策或行动方案。
entries.es: Recomendó o apoyó públicamente una causa, política o curso de acción en particular.
entries.pt-BR: Recomendou ou apoiou publicamente uma causa, política ou curso de ação específico.
